entities.summary: China is a sovereign nation in East Asia, Asia. Its capital is Beijing. Official languages include Standard Chinese (Mandarin/Putonghua). Government: Unitary Marxist-Leninist one-party socialist republic. Population: approximately 1410.0 million. Area: 9,596,961 km².
